in_sanskrit.name: साम्भु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The benevolent one, the giver of all desires, the one who is propitious and benign

in_hindi.name: साम्भ
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who protects, supports, or is propitious.

in_marathi.name: Sambhu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sambhu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sambhu is a Sanskrit name for the Hindu god Shiva, which means the God of the Universe, the God who is the supreme lord of the universe and is also known as the god of prosperity, fertility, and auspiciousness.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of the Universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sambhu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Sambhu is a Sanskrit name for the Hindu god Shiva, which means the God of the Universe, the God who is the supreme lord of the universe and is also known as the god of prosperity, fertility, and auspiciousness.
